mission.title: Maneuvers
mission.description: Help the Merovingian and the General stage a show of force for the intruder.

npc.say: Merci, {player}. Let's give our guest a good show, eh?
The usual arrangements will be made for the transfer.
Someone's been teaching old programs new tricks. These are with you, I take it?

phase.briefing:
The intruder is still stand-offish, {player}. The Machines don't seem nearly as concerned about us contacting him as they are about Zion doing it, which has given us a window to win him over, but that window may be closing: while he's been boiling the Machines in their own oil, Zion has managed to take some stumbling steps in the intruder's direction--or so they think.
It's hard to get useful information out of someone with Neanderthals horning in, so we've got to step up our efforts with the intruder. The Merovingian has proposed something involving the General. In general, I would say that's a bad idea...but nobody listens to me until it's too late, anyway.

enter.say:
I don't see much reason to be worried. This guy's way more our style than Zion's.
No, no; no trouble on the scope.

talk.say:
Bonjour, {player}. Comment allez-vous?
The General and I have been discussing a plan of attack. The intruder strikes me as a man who appreciates the effective application of force, vous voyez, and I think we have just the means of making an effective demonstration. I'll leave it to you, General...

done.say: Let's see what ol' Guts and Glory wants us to do.

talk.say: We'll be bringing some of my soldiers back into the Matrix, operative. The demonstration should be quick enough to avoid significant risk of Machine interference, but I'll appreciate it if you take good care of my men while they're here.

done.say: Yeah, yeah... All right, it's time to put this together with Flood. Head out.

phase.briefing:
I knew this was going to happen...
You'll have to see the Effectuator about the commando transfer, operative. Unfortunately, he's the only one we have available to activate the program. I want it noted that I take no responsibility for the commandos he's sure to mangle in the process.

enter.say: You're supposed to meet the Effectuator in there. I just hope he's in a big room this time...

talk.say: No problemo; I totally got it down, now--completely fool-proof. She's all set up, so just launch the program from the computer over there, stand back, and watch the magic.

done.say:
Didja ever get that sense of impending doom?
Might as well get it over with. Computer's right over there.

objective.text: Launch the transfer program from the computer

done.say: Hey, you're still alive...and humanoid. I'm gonna go ahead and call that success.

phase.briefing:
Lovely.
Go catch up with the intruder, {player}. We'll introduce him to our private squid army.
I'll figure out something to do with that other one...

enter.say: The intruder's in there, all right. No sign of hostiles.

talk.say:
Oh, you again. More books to sell me?
Wait... What is this? Out you come!

done.say:
Whoa! He switched off their stealth fields. I guess Flood was hoping to surprise him. Speaking of whom...
Okay, grab two of those guys, and hustle them outside. We've got a target.

objective.text: Lead two of the commandos outside

phase.briefing: We've drummed up a gaggle of Zionites for you to aim those soldiers at, operative. If all goes as planned, the intruder will be observing, so try not to screw this up.
